# @brand/blueprint

> Reprographic blueprint drawing furniture (GridPaper, BlueprintSheet, …).

Import from `@brand/blueprint`. Part of brand-ui — see the root `llms.txt` for routing.

## Components

- BlueprintFrame
- BlueprintSheet — The outer drafting frame for a blueprint sheet — corner ticks + title block, exactly once per page.
  - avoid: Repeating the frame/title block on inner panels — one drawing, one frame, one title block.
  - avoid: Using blueprint furniture as wallpaper — annotation is semantic and sparse; the grid is the only thing that may be everywhere.
- Callout
- Crosshair
- DimensionLine
- FigAnnotation
- GridPaper
- PlaceholderBox
- RegistrationMark
- TitleBlock
